newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore's senior minister Lee to visit UK, US.
newsitem.headline: Singapore's senior minister Lee to visit UK, US.

text.p: Singapore elder statesman Lee Kuan Yew is to visit London and New York from October 2-13, a statement from the Prime Minister's office said on Tuesday.

Lee, Singapore's former prime minister and still senior minister in the cabinet, will speak in London at Asia House, a forum for economic, commercial and cultural activities linking Asia and Europe, and at the Chairman's Club, an organisation for heads of international business.
He will also meet British political leaders.
The statement added that Lee would attend the J.P. Morgan International Council meeting in New York from October 8 to 13.
